entities.summary: Jutarnji list is a Croatian daily newspaper based in Zagreb. It was published on 6 April 1998 by EPH, which eventually changed its name in Hanza Media after being bought by Marijan Hanžeković. The newspaper is published in the Berliner format and online. Its online edition, Jutarnji.hr, is the second most-visited news website in Croatia after Index.hr. Jutarnji list is a newspaper, established in 1998. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
